changelog: 1.0.3: every network call in search/details/episodes/home wrapped silent-try/catch (HTTP_0 safe); base URL verified header/slash-insensitive.
1.0.2: added getHome alias, full-outage [] fallbacks for home/search/discovery, browser headers on every fetchv2 call.
1.0.1: hardened searchResults (correct /search/{query} route, browser headers, one retry on transient failure, graceful [] fallback).
1.0.0: initial release. Search, details and episode listings via public HTML; direct streams only returned after live media verification, with no CAPTCHA, ad-wall, login or DRM bypass.
